Name: Seaside Glade Farm
Author: Draylon
Description:
A Farm with a bit of Everything. Beach forage, beach crates, Quarry, All Fish types, Respawning Stumps and Forest Forage.
Mountain Fish are in the Big Lake on the East Side, the other rivers and smaller lakes are Forest Fish.

Should be Compatible with anything that doesnt modify the farm map.

This is technically a fusion of all 4 maps from my Four Seasons Greenhouse.

Downloads.Description: Please Report any bugs or errors to me so i can fix them asap.
